summaries.doc_first: Send each room-center beacon out through its room gap, relay it through bend pipes, and stop it at the first valid destination.
Repair the missing region of a biaxially symmetric mosaic, then use that hole shape to keep and recolor only matching outside objects.
Infer the shared pose-change and recoloring shown by center-symmetric sprite pairs, then draw the widow's missing twin.
Read the jagged color bands as a (color, thickness) program and execute it as a clockwise spiral drawing.
Color every clear edge-to-edge corridor via a legend-table lookup, then recolor corridor crossings by looking up the two corridor colors again.
Extract the hidden two-color crop and repair its damaged cells by compact-frame symmetry.
Reconstruct the only candidate shape-and-pose that matches the two projection shadows and paint it back onto the canvas.
Expand each cell into a rectangle whose height and width come from the opposite indexed axis.
Reverse each row around its own globally unique pivot pixel, or fully reverse the row if it has no pivot.
Repair the four occluded periodic quadrants, then return the uniquely different repaired quadrant.
Extend each two-pixel arrow into a colored ray that folds at gray walls.
Redistribute the vertical bars by height, then fold any overflow under the ceiling toward the side with more room.
Reconstruct each hidden emitter from colored border residues and redraw its cross rays.
Fold the four quadrant masks onto one canvas, but treat the separator-colored one as an erasing stencil.
Count the suspended water drops and pour that much water into the deepest sky-reachable empty layers while leaving sealed cavities dry.
Recolor each gray interior and stack it into the canvas corner named by its missing marker corner.
Compress separator-cut color blocks into block coordinates, then restore pink-covered blocks from the unique block-level period.
Recolor every green room object by the color that most recently flowed through a door from the source room.
Rotate each red pointer around its grey pivot so it aims at the virtual target defined by the two edge markers.
Use full-width monochrome rows as per-color switches that blank only that color inside open intervals.
Compress a 3x3 coarse partition by reading the center color of each isolated bicolored cross.
Recover the masked rectangle by mirroring only the silhouette and filling that slot with the scattered fragments.
Recover the unique door-threaded corridor route and invert the colors only on its corridor cells.
Erase objects that are covered by an even number of virtual corner-made rectangles.
Repaint the legend box by turning each grey icon row into a left-to-right color record of matching shapes.
Recover the sparse two-step sprite by subtracting the shortest wallpaper period and compressing the violations.
Collect the colors of scatter pixels hit by an invisible square spiral and output them as a row.
Reconstruct overlapping hollow square rings, then drop them in back-to-front order until they stack on the floor.
Extend each top-row source downward while spending same-colored fuel and detouring around horizontal obstacles.
Fill every cup reached through opening-aligned rays and keep the emitted yellow trails.
Read the left barcode as a turn program and draw the resulting polyline from the seed.
Erase each handled template cluster, then restamp its full shape onto matching isolated pixels.
Swap each marker's region address with its in-region offset while preserving the separator system.
Use each off-center hole as a compass, recoloring the first struck square pixel and back-filling the hole with the struck color.
Complete and recolor only the consecutive size-decreasing fragmented-frame chain below the unique source frame.
Cast the red beam opposite the pink tail, reflect it on gray diagonal mirrors, and repaint the first hit block red.
Move each colored object into the quadrant declared by the matching cell of the unique 2x2 color key.
Color the framed rooms visited by the unique shortest endpoint path according to the ordered legend strip.
Infer the hidden tile-layout law from the majority of a 3x3 tiling and output the corrected violating tile.
Stamp the mirror-difference shape from the upper panels onto the lower marker canvas.
Downscale a black-line partition grid, then recover all missing coarse cells from anti-diagonal equality and a periodic diagonal sequence.
Trace each border maroon light ray through pink reflecting squares and grey absorbers, then mark its terminal cell.
Translate each main object by the force-dot count-difference vector around its row and column bands.
Expand the multicolor structure by the monochrome panel's mask, inverting the mask when colors match.
Correct the unique panel whose rotated pattern contradicts its corner orientation marker.
Recolor the lattice foreground on ruler-selected periodic rows or columns, then erase the remote controls.
Fuse the hidden stripe by aligning partial copies using each marker pair's notch direction.
Slide each aligned object onto its area-sized stopping ring around the red marker.
Restore the mirrored hidden wall segment, then draw the unique shortest route between the red endpoints.
Transform each panel sprite by its same-colored instruction piece, then overlay the three panels with rightmost priority.
Regrow the nested-rectangle legend as Chebyshev-distance square rings around the lone marker.
Find the unique mirrored twin pair, infer its hidden axis, and mirror every other sprite across that axis.
Pick the only two fragments that can interlock to fill the rectangle's hole, then erase the rest.
Repair the polluted periodic patch, then tile that repaired phase across the marker-bounded rectangle.
Recolor the grey object with the color of the marker that reaches it in the fewest wall-avoiding steps.
Treat the recovered frame stacking order as a travel itinerary and draw the trip through frame centers.
Use the common empty cells of two stacked panels as a blueprint for fractal weaving.
Translate each sprite along the axis selected by its unique mirror symmetry, using side-mass imbalance as signed distance.
Recolor each repeated sprite from the 3x3 key block using wrapped zone offsets relative to the key zone.
Keep the color order on a single anchored path fixed while reversing only its segment-length sequence.
Complete the unique non-symmetric cell, then reinterpret its missing pixels as whole-cell paint commands.
Wrap the two pieces of a broken border ruler onto the invisible rectangle implied by four yellow corner markers.
Turn mask-size histogram into a clockwise square spiral anchored at the gray seed.
